findings.rationale: Undisclosed 5,000,000-byte cap at tests/test_outputs.py:33 removed; the verifier timeout bounds pathological input. Root cause was the 'Other keys are ignored' promise, so the plan format is now closed in dispatch-rules.md (only routes; a route only type/depart/stops; no repeated key) and enforced by load_plan/evaluate in the shared check_plan.py (tests/ and environment/app/tools byte-identical), which also rejects NaN/Infinity and unreadable JSON.
